name: AArk Granting Program
summary: Seed grants for newly launched ex situ amphibian rescue programmes for species assessed as needing rescue, plus small workshop grants and emergency grants through the year.

amount.note: Program grants: up to US$7,000 in the first year, with smaller sums in years 2 and 3

reporting: Progress reports at 6, 12, 24 and 36 months after the programme starts, as set out in the MOU.

status.quote: Applications for 2026 grants cycle are now closed - stay tuned for the 2027 cycle!

geography.quote: We welcome applications from all countries, especially those that have established National Programs.

access.quote: We welcome applications from all countries, especially those that have established National Programs.

window.quote: Applications for 2026 grants cycle are now closed - stay tuned for the 2027 cycle!

amount.quote: Funded programs will receive up to US$7,000 in the first year. Additional funds will be available for year 2 (up to US$5,000) and year 3 (up to US$3,000) if projects have met their stated objectives

applicant_types.quote: Amphibian Ark can provide funding to NGOs and, in some cases, government institutions involved in amphibian conservation.

reporting.quote: Send a progress report 6, 12, 24, and 36 months after the program starts as per the MOU.
